run_nvs_rendering: run the NVS script to render novel view RGB, silhouette, and visibility images from camera trajectories
run_bullet_time_rendering: run the NVS script with bullet_time flag to render a frozen-frame bullet time effect across camera poses
construct_rays_nvs: construct camera rays for novel view synthesis given image size, camera poses, near-far bounds, and a render mask
render_nerf_rays: render rays through the NeRF model to produce coarse RGB, depth, silhouette, and visibility predictions
save_nvs_video: save rendered RGB, silhouette, and visibility frames as MP4 videos using the save_vid utility
